name: Super Real Mahjong Dousoukai
summary: Super Real Mahjong Dousoukai is the GBA version of the popular Super Real Mahjong series. It features all the girls from PII to P7 in it, and while the strip mahjong aspect of the series is gone due to the family friendly nature of the GBA, it has been replaced with the characters donning many different costumes from nurses to wedding dresses.
